objective: Replace the pathological full-official-DSH npm coexistence resolver gate with a bounded authoritative cohort-manifest compatibility audit while preserving a real default-npm install gate for the v0.3.1 candidate, then perform a second conservative cleanup of historical remote/local branches whose unique work is proven superseded or already preserved on main. Finish with a release-readiness verdict for v0.3.1 without publishing it.
context: Current main contains the prepared @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1 candidate, concise English/Chinese READMEs, and the first safe branch cleanup. Two prior gates proved that npm's full @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 coexistence resolution is not a useful bounded acceptance check in this environment: even --package-lock-only ran about 11 minutes at roughly 1.3 GB without completing. The candidate itself already installs successfully from a packed tarball with npm's normal resolver, no peer bypass, and all 20 direct DSH peer/dev pins are aligned to the official 0.1.1-rc.2 cohort. Redesign the official-host check so it uses authoritative public registry manifests for @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 and the candidate's direct DSH peer packages, verifies the expected exact cohort exists, and checks relevant cross-cohort dependency/peer requirements for compatibility without materializing or fully resolving the giant host graph. The audit must be bounded, deterministic enough for release gating, fail closed on missing/malformed/incompatible manifests, and must not weaken or bypass npm peer semantics. Do not add a resolver-bypass flag. Prefer no new dependency; if semver evaluation is needed, use an existing safe mechanism or a small well-tested implementation rather than adding runtime dependencies. For branch cleanup, the current remote set is main plus 12 historical branches: feat/v0.3-model-selection-trace, feat/v0.3-model-selection-trace-integrated, fix/opencode-go-public-model-catalog, ops/opencode-go-catalog-remediation, release/v0.3.0-publish, test/dsh-latest-runtime-audit, test/opencode-go-catalog-diagnosis, test/v0.3-dynamic-runtime-controls-smoke, test/v0.3-final-isolated-acceptance, test/v0.3-final-opencode-acceptance, test/v0.3-model-selection-trace-smoke, test/v0.3-runtime-compat-smoke. PR #15 explicitly says feat/v0.3-model-selection-trace was superseded by merged PR #34. Other historical test/release branches may be deleted only if their unique patches are purely superseded/ephemeral or their authoritative evidence is already preserved on main. Preserve any branch with still-useful unique product/remediation code, especially the OpenCode catalog branches unless equivalence/supersession is proven. Do not merge/cherry-pick/rebase branches merely to enable deletion.

acceptance_criteria: The packed v0.3.1 candidate installs in a disposable directory with npm's normal resolver and no --legacy-peer-deps, --force, --omit=peer, or equivalent bypass, and installed package/runtime identity is 0.3.1.

The redesigned official DSH gate completes within a bounded practical runtime and memory footprint without invoking full host materialization/resolution, verifies @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 plus all direct Crew DSH peers from authoritative public manifests, and rejects any missing, mismatched, or incompatible cohort relationship.
The redesigned gate has deterministic regression coverage for PASS and at least one incompatible/missing-manifest failure path without requiring credentials or the user's official DSH state.
Frozen install, full deterministic tests, client build, pack payload audit, and npm publish dry-run all PASS; no unintended generated diff remains.
Version identity remains consistently 0.3.1 and no real npm/tag/GitHub Release mutation occurs.

Historical branches are deleted only with explicit ancestry/patch-equivalence/supersession-or-main-evidence proof. feat/v0.3-model-selection-trace should be deleted if PR #15 -> merged PR #34 supersession and no unique still-needed code are confirmed. Ambiguous OpenCode catalog/remediation branches must be preserved unless their unique patches are proven integrated or superseded.
No open-PR branch, unique unresolved product/remediation work, main, or tag is deleted/rewritten. The Result Contract lists every deleted and preserved branch with the proof/reason.
If all release gates pass, Result summary includes exactly V031_RELEASE_READY: PASS. If any required gate cannot be proven, return BLOCKED/FAIL with precise evidence and do not publish 0.3.1.
